## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (55%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
Simulated frozen section cannot exclude InSitu (44%) [F1] and flags tumor at all four margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 55%, InSitu 44%, Benign 1%, Normal 1% | Near-even split between top classes |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage target) | Cannot separate at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 1% OOD percentile [F6] | Passes QC; 12/12 regions kept |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models share top class |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive, 2/5 InSitu (63%–66% similarity) [F5] | Mixed neighbors; nearest is InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 8, 9) · context · Above typical [F2]; negative weight (-1.60) pulls against invasion · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive weight (+1.27) [F3]; 19/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 6, 8) · ↑ invasive · Positive weight (+0.85) [F4], but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 1, 4) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (+0.40 weight), but 3/20 AI spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive score more than random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Dense TILs mask intact basement membranes, making InSitu (44%, matching nearest neighbor BACH_0046) mimic invasion.
- Simulated frozen-section and severity-3 JPEG degradation distort morphology or margins; confirmatory stains are blocked.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 4, 5, 0**: Confirm true stromal invasion (76%–92% risk) versus duct-confined InSitu.
2. **Regions 4, 8, 9, 1, 6**: Check whether dense TILs obscure ducts; manually verify mitoses.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8, 1**: Verify superior/medial (430 um), inferior (215 um), lateral (108 um) margins.
